title: Existence and uniqueness of section tensor representatives
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For each scheme $T$ use its small pro-etale site, small relative to the module coefficient universe [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and the internal and section-module categories $\mathcal I_T,\mathcal S_T$, exact section equivalence $E_T$, their unbounded derived categories, localized equivalence $D(E_T)$, conjugate derived tensor $\mathsf T_T$, unit $\mathsf U_T$, and signed direct-sum total $\operatorname{Tot}_T$ of [def-pd-section-derived-tensor-data]. Assume the chosen derived categories exist, as in that construction. Write $Q_T^{\mathrm i},Q_T^{\mathrm s}$ for cochain localization. The internal localization tensor map $\mu_{P,Q}:Q_T^{\mathrm i}P\otimes^{\mathbf L}Q_T^{\mathrm i}Q\to Q_T^{\mathrm i}\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q)$ is that of [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Write $\kappa_P:D(E_T)Q_T^{\mathrm i}P\cong Q_T^{\mathrm s}E_TP$, $c_{M,N}:D(E_T)(M\otimes^{\mathbf L}N)\cong\mathsf T_T(D(E_T)M,D(E_T)N)$, and $\ell_{P,Q}:D(E_T)Q_T^{\mathrm i}\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q)\to Q_T^{\mathrm s}\operatorname{Tot}_T(E_TP,E_TQ)$ for the fixed section localization, tensor, and localized ordinary total comparisons of [def-pd-section-derived-tensor-data]. Here $E_T$ also denotes its termwise action on complexes, and composition below is read right to left.

For every scheme $T$, there exists exactly one natural transformation
$$q_T:\mathsf T_T\circ(Q_T^{\mathrm s}\times Q_T^{\mathrm s})\longrightarrow Q_T^{\mathrm s}\circ\operatorname{Tot}_T$$
satisfying all three conditions:
(1) For every pair of unbounded internal cochain complexes $P,Q$,
$$q_{T;E_TP,E_TQ}=\ell_{P,Q}\circ D(E_T)(\mu_{P,Q})\circ c_{Q_T^{\mathrm i}P,Q_T^{\mathrm i}Q}^{-1}\circ\mathsf T_T(\kappa_P^{-1},\kappa_Q^{-1}).$$
(2) For every pair of unbounded section-module cochain complexes $A,B$, if either $A$ or $B$ is K-flat, then $q_{T;A,B}$ is invertible. K-flat has the independent-coefficient meaning of [def-pc-kflat-complex]: $\operatorname{Tot}_T(H,K)$ is acyclic for every acyclic section-module complex $H$, with no requirement that the coefficient universe equal either site universe and no requirement of flat terms.
(3) There exists an isomorphism $\mathsf U_T\cong R_{T,\mathrm{sec}}[0]$, where $R_{T,\mathrm{sec}}$ is the regular section-ring module and $[0]$ is the degree-zero single-complex functor. The unit clause asserts existence, not a choice or uniqueness of this unit isomorphism.
